title: Bar Basics
tagline: The bar opener-to-closer playbook: prep, pours, pace, and pass-down.
summary: A practical, non-certification course that teaches new bartenders and barbacks how a well-run bar works — from stocking a well to closing the books. Pairs well with Alcohol Safety for full compliance.
outcomes: Open and close a bar without leaving surprises for the next shift
Pour with consistent speed and cost control
Handle a three-deep rail without losing your head
Communicate cleanly with servers and the kitchen
